plan: Reproduce NumPad6→Right with Shift held before/after key-down on current build; compare left/right Shift, Ctrl and physical Right.

verification: Verify Shift+NumPad6 selects text like Shift+Right; Ctrl+NumPad6 still moves by word.
Test both Shift sides, NumLock on/off, both key orders, and no stuck modifier after release.
